fields.label: string (human/display name)
fields.attributes: Array<{ key: string, value: string, prop: string|null }> — prop is the SEON/mgx token grounding the value

fields.subject: string (individual id)
fields.prop: string|null — the SEON/mgx property token; see edgeKinds → tmct: mapping

Result.shape: { ok: true, value: T } | { ok: false, miss: Miss }

Miss.shape: { reason: MISS_REASONS, detail: string, term: string|null }

capabilitiesModel: A provider advertises `capabilities: string[]` (service names it implements). A service outside the set is negotiated away to miss(CAPABILITY_ABSENT) — never an error. Source services (snippet, context) may be advertised yet answer miss(NO_SOURCE) when no working tree exists.

resolve.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
resolve.purpose: The resolveSymbol seam: map a free term to an individual + runner-up candidates. Every id-taking service consumes a resolved id.

describe.result: { individual: Individual, out: Edge[], incoming: Edge[] }
describe.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
describe.purpose: Full typed portrait of one individual: its attributes and its outgoing/incoming edges.

members.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
members.purpose: A class's methods + attributes (via the contains relation) — replaces reading the class body.

subclasses.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
subclasses.purpose: Forward bases + the transitive reverse inheritance closure (who extends this).

exports.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
exports.purpose: A module's curated public API (resolved __all__ / re-exports).

signature.result: { id, label, class, params, returns, raises, decorators, doc, selfFields, flags }
signature.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
signature.purpose: The compact API surface of a symbol without its body.

edges.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
edges.purpose: Outgoing edges of one closed kind from an individual (an honest empty array is not a miss).
edges.note: An unknown kind (outside EDGE_KINDS) is a programming error and throws TypeError, not a miss.

impact.result: { total: number, levels: Array<Array<{ id, label, via, tests }>> }
impact.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
impact.purpose: The transitive dependent closure the interpreter cannot compute without provider truth.

snippet.result: { path: string, span: { start, end }, body: string|null }
snippet.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
snippet.purpose: The exact source span of a symbol. A provider with no working tree returns miss(NO_SOURCE) honestly.

context.result: { text: string, tier: string } (a sized edit bundle)
context.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
context.purpose: The composed edit bundle (exemplar, siblings, registration, insertion region). Source-reaching.

architecture.result: { modules: number, packages: Array<[dir, count]>, hubs: Array<{ id, label, importers }> }
architecture.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
architecture.purpose: Package/module shape + the most-imported hub modules. Optional package prefix scopes it.

untested.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
untested.purpose: Modules with no covering test module (via the tests relation).

stats.result: { total: number, classes: Array<{ class: string, count: number }>, truncated: boolean }
stats.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
stats.purpose: Per-tmct:class individual counts, read straight from the payload.

history.result: { commits: Array<{ id, label, author, date, message }> }
history.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
history.purpose: The commits that touched an individual (tmct:commit individuals via tmct:touches).

search.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
search.purpose: Lexical, provider-local locate. An empty result set is honest, not a miss.

ask.result: { content: string, tmct_ask: object } (the composed NL round-trip envelope)
ask.concurrency: concurrent-safe: reads immutable graph truth; no shared mutable state
ask.purpose: The mechanical, zero-model NL query over the graph — tmct's whole reason to exist.
